shell.title: Project template skeleton
shell.description: This template contains only the architecture, conventions and code structure. Add features under src/features as described in docs/03-代码结构.md.

common.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Please check it and try again.
common.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
common.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
common.notFound: The requested item does not exist or is not visible to you.
common.methodNotAllowed: This request method is not supported.
common.conflict: The data has been changed or already exists. Please refresh and try again.
common.payloadTooLarge: The submitted content is too large.
common.unsupportedMediaType: This content type is not supported.
common.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please try again later.
common.internalError: Internal server error. Please contact the administrator with the trace ID.
common.dependencyUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

client.network: Cannot reach the server. Please check your network and try again.
client.invalidResponse: The server returned an unrecognized response.

sn.mesNoPageLogin: MES interface accounts cannot sign in to pages
sn.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this
sn.factoryForbidden: You can only operate data of your authorized production orgs: {{factory}}
sn.conflictRetry: Data is being changed by another operation, please retry
sn.piBusy: PI {{pi}} is busy with another operation (generate, delete, allocate or transfer), please retry later
sn.userEmpNoInvalid: Employee No. must be 3–32 letters, digits or -
sn.userNameRequired: Name is required, at most 64 characters
sn.userRoleFixed: MES interface accounts and page accounts cannot switch roles with each other
sn.userFactoryRequired: Operators and auditors must be authorized for at least one production org
sn.userMesFactoryRequired: MES interface accounts must be bound to one production org
sn.userAdminNoFactory: The system administrator is not bound to a production org
sn.userAdminUnique: There is only one system administrator: you cannot create one or change an account into one
sn.userPasswordWeak: Password must be 4–64 characters containing both letters and digits; only letters, digits and ! {'@'} # $ & * - are allowed
sn.userPasswordSame: New password must differ from the current one
sn.userSelfDisable: You cannot disable your own account
sn.userLastAdmin: At least one enabled administrator must remain
sn.userManageForbidden: Only the system administrator can manage accounts
sn.userSuperAdminFixed: The system administrator must stay enabled; its role cannot change and it cannot be disabled
sn.userNotMes: This account is not an MES interface account
sn.userSecretUnavailable: The secret of this account cannot be viewed (SN_SECRET was changed, or the account predates viewable secrets); please reset the secret
sn.factoryDisabled: Production org {{factory}} is disabled in Kingdee
sn.mesTestRequired: “MES integration” can be enabled only after the URL and credential (not needed with no auth) are filled in and the connection test passes
sn.mesDisableBlocked: Production org {{factory}} still has unfinished pushes: {{detail}}; resume them, wait for MES receipts, or have HQ confirm / void manually
sn.mesNotEnabled: Production org {{factory}} does not have “MES integration” enabled
sn.k3SecretUnreadable: The Kingdee app secret cannot be decrypted (SN_SECRET was changed): enter the app secret again in “Kingdee connection” on the Production orders page
sn.k3TestFailed: Kingdee connection test failed, not saved: {{message}}
sn.k3ResetFailed: Connection test with the .env settings failed, defaults not restored: {{message}}
sn.orderNotFound: Production order {{bill_no}} is not in the snapshot (not approved, or not synced yet)
sn.orderLineNotFound: Material line {{bill_no}} / {{seq}} is not in the snapshot
sn.orderSyncBusy: Order sync is running, please retry later
sn.attachInvalid: Attachment item cannot be empty and must be at most 64 characters
sn.attachFillK3: Kingdee already has the attachment item; it cannot be changed on the page
sn.lengthFillInvalid: Length must be at most 64 characters and cannot be empty when set in batch
sn.lengthFillChinese: Length {{value}} contains Chinese characters; change it to a length without Chinese
sn.unitFillInvalid: Unit must be at most 64 characters
sn.unitFillChinese: Unit {{value}} contains Chinese characters; enter a unit without Chinese (e.g. M, m, L)
sn.lineEditGenerated: Material line {{bill_no}} / {{seq}} has SNs; attachment item, length and unit cannot be changed. Delete the line's SNs first
sn.lineEditAllocated: Material line {{bill_no}} / {{seq}} has allocated SNs; attachment item, length and unit cannot be changed. Delete the line's SNs first
sn.alertNotFound: Order change alert not found or already handled
sn.alertActionInvalid: This alert cannot be handled this way
sn.alertMapTargetInvalid: The target material line must be another line of this bill in the snapshot: {{seq}}
sn.alertMapFrozen: {{count}} SNs of the lost material line are in unconfirmed or failed batches; confirm the mapping after those batches are confirmed
sn.ruleCodeInvalid: Rule code must be 1–64 letters, digits, _ or -
sn.ruleNameRequired: Rule name is required, at most 128 characters
sn.ruleCategoryInvalid: A rule can only be bound to a PI
sn.ruleCategoryRequired: Fill in the PI the rule is bound to (at most 64 characters)
sn.ruleInUse: Rule {{rule_code}} has generated SNs and cannot be deleted
sn.ruleAssigned: Rule {{rule_code}} is assigned to PI {{pi}} and cannot be deleted
sn.ruleAffixInvalid: The separators before and after the length may each have at most 16 characters
sn.ruleLengthPadInvalid: Length zero-padding must be 0–32 digits (0 = no padding)
sn.rulePrefixConflict: Prefix {{prefix}} is already in use. Please use another one.
sn.ruleCharsetLength: Charset length must equal the base
sn.ruleCharsetDuplicate: Charset must not contain duplicate characters
sn.ruleSnTooLong: Prefix + serial + separators + length + unit + suffix must not exceed 64 characters
sn.rulePrefixFormatLocked: Prefix {{prefix}} is already used with base {{base}} and a {{seq_len}}-digit serial; base, serial length and charset cannot change under the same prefix, use a new prefix
sn.rulePrefixOverlap: Prefix {{prefix}} and prefix {{other}} of PI {{pi}} start with one another and may produce identical SNs; please change it
sn.rulePrefixChangeRequired: Rule {{rule_code}} version {{version}} is already used by PI {{other_pi}}; enter a new prefix for this PI
sn.ruleGlobalReadonly: Only the system administrator can modify or delete global rules: {{rule_code}}
sn.ruleFactoryRequired: Please choose the production org the rule belongs to
sn.ruleSeqStartInvalid: Start number must be a positive integer not greater than the rule's max serial {{max}}
sn.genScopeInvalid: Generation scope must be bills or material lines under the same PI
sn.genNotGeneratable: The selected scope cannot be generated: {{detail}}
sn.genPiQuotaEmpty: The selected scope has no quota left to generate
sn.genRuleExhausted: Rule digits exhausted: max serial {{max}}, this run needs up to {{end}}
sn.genPreviewRequired: Run the preview first before generating
sn.genPreviewChanged: Preview conditions changed, please preview again
sn.genPreviewStale: Max SN of PI {{pi}} changed from {{expected}} to {{actual}}; preview is stale, please preview again
sn.genPreviewUsed: This preview was already used for a generation, please preview again
sn.genBusy: PI {{pi}} is generating, please retry later
sn.genDuplicateSn: Full SN {{sn}} duplicates an existing SN of PI {{pi}}; the whole generation was rolled back (no auto-skip)
sn.genSeqRangeInvalid: Start and end serial numbers must be positive integers, and the end cannot be less than the start
sn.genImportedSn: Full SN {{sn}} is an imported SN (PI {{pi}}) and cannot be generated; the whole generation was rolled back (no auto-skip)
sn.deleteTargetInvalid: Select the documents or material lines to delete, or enter SNs (start / end)
sn.deleteRangeInvalid: Start and end SNs must be on the same serial (same serial PI), and the end cannot come before the start
sn.deleteNothing: There are no SNs to delete in the selection
sn.genQtyOverMax: At most {{max}} SNs per generation, the selected lines total {{qty}}; select fewer lines per run, or contact the administrator
sn.genCanceled: Generation canceled; all written SNs were deleted
sn.genCancelNotRunning: This generation has already finished and cannot be canceled
sn.allocNothing: No SNs to allocate in the selected scope
sn.pushNothing: Production org {{factory}} has no SNs or batches of PI {{pi}} to push
sn.batchNotPending: Batch {{batch_no}} is already {{result}} and cannot be handled again
sn.batchNotVoidable: Batch {{batch_no}} may already have been processed by MES (invalid or mismatched response, receipt or content mismatch); it cannot be voided, only settled by an MES receipt or confirmed manually
sn.batchBasisRequired: A basis is required (e.g. written confirmation from MES, at most 500 characters)
sn.dalertNotFound: Delivery alert not found or already handled
sn.exportNothing: Bill {{bill_no}} of PI {{pi}} has no allocated SNs
sn.importFileInvalid: The import file must be an xlsx file
sn.importFileTooLarge: The import file cannot exceed {{max}} MB
sn.importHeaderInvalid: The header row of the import file is missing: {{missing}} (columns {{required}} are required, {{optional}} are optional; columns are found by name in any order, other columns are ignored)
sn.importHeaderDuplicate: The column "{{column}}" appears more than once in the header of the import file (including aliases), so it is unclear which one to read
sn.importEmpty: The import file has no data rows
sn.importTooMany: At most {{max}} rows per import; the file has {{rows}} rows
sn.importHasIssues: {{count}} rows cannot be imported, so nothing in the file was imported; fix them and import again
sn.importNotFound: Import {{import_no}} does not exist or was deleted
sn.importDeleteAllocated: {{count}} SNs of import {{import_no}} are already allocated, so it cannot be deleted (only when all SNs are waiting for allocation)
sn.importConflict: SN {{sn}} was just generated or imported, so nothing in the file was imported; check again and import
sn.trScopeInvalid: Transfer scope must be a whole bill or by material code (one or several material codes)
sn.trMaterialRequired: Select at least one material code when transferring by material code
sn.trLineModeInvalid: A material code is transferred in full, by range or by quantity
sn.trLineDuplicate: Material code {{material}} (attachment item {{attach_no}}) is selected more than once
sn.trLineEmpty: The source bill has no SNs of material code {{material}} (attachment item {{attach_no}})
sn.trSnRequired: Start SN is required for a range transfer (start only = single SN)
sn.trQtyInvalid: The quantity must be a positive integer
sn.trQtyExceeds: Material code {{material}} (attachment item {{attach_no}}) has only {{available}} transferable SNs, fewer than the {{qty}} requested
sn.trTargetPiMismatch: Target bill {{bill_no}} belongs to PI {{pi}}, not the target PI entered
sn.trTargetOrgMismatch: For a bill transfer the target org must be the org of target bill {{bill_no}}: {{factory}}
sn.trTargetLineNotMatch: Target bill {{bill_no}} has no line with the same material code {{material}} and attachment item {{attach_no}}: only the same material code and attachment item can be transferred
sn.trNothing: No transferable SNs in the selected scope
sn.trSameTarget: Target is identical to the source
sn.trLengthMismatch: Target material length {{target}} differs from the length {{current}} on the SN; cannot transfer
sn.trTargetBillInvalid: Target bill {{bill_no}} must be in the snapshot with a PI; for a bill transfer it must differ from the source bill
sn.trTargetLineRequired: Target bill {{bill_no}} has several lines with material code {{material}} and attachment item {{attach_no}}; choose the target ERP line No.
sn.trTargetLineInvalid: Target ERP line No. {{seq}} is not in the target bill
sn.trRangeInvalid: Range {{start_sn}} ~ {{end_sn}} is not within the selected bill, material code and attachment item, or spans different serial PIs
sn.trLocateNotFound: {{q}} not found: enter a full SN, bill No. or PI (only allocated SNs of your authorized orgs are searched)
sn.queryPiRequired: A PI is required to view SNs of the same PI across production orgs
sn.queryPiNotOwned: Your production org has no SNs of PI {{pi}}; other orgs cannot be viewed
sn.queryRangePiRequired: A PI is required when querying by serial range
sn.queryRangeInvalid: {{value}} is not a serial or full SN of PI {{pi}}
sn.queryRangeReversed: Start serial {{start}} is greater than end serial {{end}}
sn.exportTooLarge: At most {{max}} rows per export; please narrow the filters

auth.tokenInvalid: Session expired, please sign in again
auth.sessionReplaced: This account signed in on another page; this page has been signed out
auth.passwordChanged: Your password was changed or reset: please sign in again with the new password
auth.userNoFactory: This account is not authorized for any production org; please contact the system administrator
